sermon.title: Eternal Life Clarified
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that eternal life is knowing God and Jesus Christ, illustrated by his father’s hunting and Job’s knowledge of his Redeemer. Through the lawyer and the Good Samaritan and the rich young ruler who lacked one commandment—covetousness—he shows eternal life involves action, and warns that searching the scriptures without coming to Jesus is not life.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Job placed “just after Abraham” and “seventeen hundred or so years before”; Samaritans’ origin via the king of Assyria; “defraud” attributed to Luke 18 (it appears in Mark 10:19); “Matthew 9:4” cited as the same account as John 5:18; Leviticus 19 vs. 1 Corinthians 11 as the holiness chapter. Sensitive content kept as spoken: a man told homosexuality is a sin “you go to hell for” who said God made him that way (repented of every sin but one); “I know you [unclear], you don’t have the love of God in you”; all roads of religions refuted.
